findings.claim: Bihar Tourism's current official cuisine pages document Thekua as a traditional Bihar sweet associated with Chhath Puja and Khichdi as a common Bihar food with Makar Sankranti and festive associations.
findings.product_implication: Dish pages should model ritual or seasonal occasion context independently from current Patna availability.

findings.claim: The 2026 Bihar Saras Mela at Gyan Bhawan is documented as a ten-day event through September 29 with around 135 stalls and traditional food participation; current reporting also records more than Rs 68.56 lakh in business during its first three days.
findings.product_implication: Event pages should expose food categories and dated commercial observations without converting them into permanent venue or demand claims.

findings.claim: The March 2026 Reddit litti hunt identifies Chaurasiya Litti and Gopi Krishna Litti around the Mahavir Mandir/GPO Golambar area and additional street-style leads near the RJD office and Maurya Lok.
findings.product_implication: Community evidence should retain exact locality resolution and be promoted only after independent verification.

findings.claim: Current third-party creator indexes identify Foodie Robin (@foodie_robin_) as a Bihar-focused food/travel creator and list several other Patna food creators, but audience and engagement figures vary across providers.
findings.product_implication: Creator authority should be calculated from geographic specificity, dish/place linkage, source quality and recency rather than follower count alone.

findings.claim: Current food-discovery products increasingly convert saved social content into maps: Waybites maps creator videos, TasteMap turns forwarded reels into personal food maps, BiteVault combines video saving with visited/open-now states, and rec'd uses save states plus creator following.
findings.product_implication: Crave Hunt should not compete on generic saving alone; its differentiator should be evidence-aware local intelligence, dish specificity, locality context and historical state.

dedupe_actions: No new canonical venue records were promoted from Reddit or creator indexes.
Saras Mela remains one event entity with dated observations rather than duplicate event records.
Thekua and Khichdi official tourism pages strengthen canonical dish context but do not imply Patna-specific availability.
Creator metrics remain dated observations and are not merged into permanent authority attributes.
implementation: Add a reusable culinary-context taxonomy separating dish identity, occasion, season, ritual role and Patna availability.
Add source-independence as a research quality metric so multiple pages repeating one upstream claim do not count as independent corroboration.
Update product plan to treat event-to-dish relationships as first-class evidence links.
next_build: Implement evidence timelines and contextual dish/event relationships on public locality, dish, place and event pages, with independent-source counts and explicit Patna-availability status.
